dct_description_sm:
This dataset is a subset of the Killed or Seriously Injured (KSI) dataset from 2006 to 2023. These events include traffic collisions involving a motorcyclist where a person was either killed or seriously injured.

 

The most current Killed or Seriously Injured (KSI) dataset (2006 - present) is published and activiely maintained by the City of Toronto and is available through the City of Toronto Open Data Portal. Please visit the Motor Vehicle Collisions Involving Killed or Seriously Injured Persons to access the latest dataset. This dataset may include updates to records from previous years, as well as additional or revised data fields. New records and updates may continue to be added on an ongoing basis.

 

For questions related to the KSI dataset, please contact: VolumeCollision_Requests@toronto.ca
